sizeReason: Two complete event records contain 18 separately reviewed spoken/narration fields, including both long honor-dependent speeches. All event commands are verified byte-identical.

review.notes: Both complete English event scripts inspected; all 18 spoken/narration source/Greek pairs read in full. Shared milk sentence corrected and re-read in both events. Both honor-dependent speeches preserve every point, stairs/stone effort, principles and challenge; all numbers and controls retained. Event validator locks every command byte outside the nine known speak/message fields per event, including actors, movement, timings, item IDs, quest removal, reward and the permanent 25-health increase. Mutation probes reject changed timing, actor, reward, health and dialogue response IDs.
